summary: Docs-only change. ADR 0010 and 0011 cover every brief item with options, trade-offs, decision and consequences; external claims cite sources the reviewer was told were verified; cross-references (ADR 0004, java-testing rules 8 and 11, AC6.2, GET /payments/{id} in T-021) resolve. One nit on a forward-looking contract statement.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: docs/adr/0010-idempotent-payment-initiation.md: header 1-255, key+request_hash on payments row in same transaction, ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING then read, replay 201, 422 on different body, 400 on missing, no expiry; options Stripe table, cache, 409 vs 422.

docs/adr/0011-payment-state-machine.md: six states, transition table, illegal moves throw DomainException subtype, enum+table, @Version, drivers per phase; options Spring State Machine, state pattern, status column.
docs/adr/0010 'payment-service boundary': payment-db, no synchronous ledger call, ledger account ids, own Money with revisit trigger.
docs/spec.md AC3.2 now says 422 Problem Details; docs/adr/README.md rows for 0010 and 0011.

findings.description: Consequences say 'the contract documents it' for replay bodies changing after status changes; no contract exists yet. It reads as present fact rather than an obligation.
findings.suggestion: Reword to 'the OpenAPI contract (T-021) must document it'.
